snippet.title: 🔥NEW Action-Strategy game: Tremble of Towers | Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2496330/Tremble_of_Towers/?utm_source=youtube&utm_content=trailer

Tremble of Towers is a new Action-Strategy game built on one rule: EVERY STRUCTURE. MANY POSSIBLITIES.

Build an Arc Turret from Ice and it slows 4 enemies at once. Build it from Magma and it burns. Lead, Wood, Starium... every mineral changes what it does. No two defenses ever look the same.

And you're not watching from above, you're on the ground. Repair walls under fire, mine, scout, and clean up what slips past your guns.

Grab 3 friends (or go solo), Hold the line, and Keep the Goal Stone standing.

Tower defense elements | Solo or 4-player co-op | Procedural maps | Escalating waves

#coop #indiegame #strategy #gaming #towerdefense
